card.name: Words before an underscore in identifiers
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word or number just before an underscore joins it to the next part, in URLs, file names, SELinux labels and code identifiers.

modes.label: SELinux labels
modes.description: Partway through context names such as unconfined_u or httpd_sys_content_t.

modes.label: URL and file names
modes.description: Parts of underscore-joined names in links and image file names.

modes.label: Code identifiers
modes.description: A word before an underscore in programming names.

card.writes: It favors rare name pieces and suppresses the uppercase identifier pieces that follow an underscore.
card.plain: It fires on a word or number right before an underscore in a file name, link or code label.
